nodes.label: Organic
nodes.reads: The item or source data carries an organic claim or label; check the specific jurisdiction when it matters.

nodes.label: Vegetarian
nodes.reads: The item is marked or described as vegetarian, usually meaning no meat or fish ingredients.

nodes.label: Vegan
nodes.reads: The item is marked or described as avoiding animal-derived ingredients or use.

nodes.label: Transparent
nodes.reads: The source provides clearer ingredients, sourcing, governance, pricing, code, or policy information than the category norm.

nodes.label: Palm-oil-free
nodes.reads: The item is marked as avoiding palm oil or palm-derived ingredients in the current source data.

nodes.label: Free
nodes.reads: The option is free to use or access in its main public form.

nodes.label: No added sugar
nodes.reads: The item is marked as having no added sugar in the source data.

nodes.label: Mainstream
nodes.reads: The option is easy to find through ordinary retail, app stores, banks, schools, or public institutions.

nodes.label: Fair Trade
nodes.reads: Fair Trade marks goods checked by certifiers against farmer and worker standards.

nodes.label: Open source
nodes.reads: The code can be inspected or reused to some degree; source-available is weaker than OSI open source, so licenses still matter.

nodes.label: Rainforest Alliance
nodes.reads: Rainforest Alliance certifies farms and supply chains against its farm, forest, climate, and livelihood standard.

nodes.label: Closed source
nodes.reads: The code or system is not publicly inspectable in a way that lets users independently audit it.

nodes.label: Freemium
nodes.reads: The option offers a free tier while reserving meaningful capacity, features, or convenience for paid plans.

nodes.label: Affordable
nodes.reads: The option is comparatively low-cost or economical for the category.

nodes.label: Privacy
nodes.reads: The option limits data collection, exposure, tracking, or third-party dependence compared with category norms.

nodes.label: Cruelty-free
nodes.reads: The item is marked as avoiding animal testing, though the exact standard can vary by source.

nodes.label: Reusable
nodes.reads: The option is designed to be used repeatedly rather than discarded after one use.

nodes.label: Self-hostable
nodes.reads: A person or organization can run the service on infrastructure they control.

nodes.label: B Corp
nodes.reads: B Lab certifies B Corps against social, environmental, governance, and transparency standards.

nodes.label: Nonprofit
nodes.reads: The organization is structured as a nonprofit or public-interest institution rather than a conventional profit-maximizing company.

nodes.label: Public resource
nodes.reads: The resource is maintained for broad public benefit, often by a government, nonprofit, school, library, or civic body.

nodes.label: Accessible
nodes.reads: The option pays attention to disability access, low-barrier use, readable design, or assistive-technology support.

nodes.label: Technical
nodes.reads: The option rewards technical confidence or specialized knowledge more than a typical mainstream choice.

nodes.label: Digital literacy
nodes.reads: The resource helps people understand, use, question, or protect themselves in digital systems.

nodes.label: Media literacy
nodes.reads: The resource helps people judge sources, claims, images, platforms, and information environments.

nodes.label: Repairable
nodes.reads: The option can be fixed, maintained, or extended instead of being replaced quickly.

nodes.label: Subscription
nodes.reads: The option depends on a recurring payment or membership model.

nodes.label: Plastic-free
nodes.reads: The item is designed to avoid plastic in the product, packaging, or recurring consumables.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.reads: The resource is useful for inquiry, evidence gathering, scholarship, or serious background work.

nodes.label: School support
nodes.reads: The resource is especially useful for students, teachers, schools, or structured learning contexts.

nodes.label: EPA Safer Choice
nodes.reads: The U.S. EPA lists Safer Choice products after reviewing their chemical ingredients.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.reads: The resource helps with laws, regulation, civic institutions, governance, or policy analysis.

nodes.label: Durable
nodes.reads: The option is built or maintained for longer useful life than disposable or fast-cycle alternatives.

nodes.label: Career skills
nodes.reads: The resource helps people build skills that can support work, credentials, or career mobility.

nodes.label: Certified
nodes.reads: The item carries some form of certification or program listing, but the specific standard still matters.

nodes.label: No ads
nodes.reads: The option does not rely on ordinary advertising inside the main user experience.

nodes.label: Interactive
nodes.reads: The option includes exercises, tools, practice, simulations, or other active learning surfaces.

nodes.label: Open access
nodes.reads: The material is freely available to read, use, or learn from without ordinary paywall barriers.

nodes.label: Open data
nodes.reads: The resource publishes reusable data with public access and some permission to inspect or reuse it.

nodes.label: Free tier
nodes.reads: The service has a usable free plan, even if some features require payment.

nodes.label: Coding
nodes.reads: The resource teaches or supports programming, software development, scripting, or code literacy.

nodes.label: AI literacy
nodes.reads: The resource helps people understand, evaluate, or safely use AI systems.

nodes.label: Independent
nodes.reads: The organization or project is meaningfully independent from larger platform, conglomerate, state, or advertiser control.

nodes.label: Paid
nodes.reads: The option normally requires payment for ordinary use.

nodes.label: Cybersecurity
nodes.reads: The resource helps people reduce digital security risks such as account takeover, malware, scams, or unsafe configuration.

nodes.label: Data literacy
nodes.reads: The resource helps people understand, analyze, visualize, verify, or question data.

nodes.label: Evidence-backed
nodes.reads: The option is grounded in transparent evidence, evaluation, citations, or tested practice.

nodes.label: Circular
nodes.reads: The option supports reuse, resale, repair, refill, recycling, or material loops rather than one-way consumption.

nodes.label: Community
nodes.reads: The option depends on, supports, or is maintained by a user, local, learning, or volunteer community.

nodes.label: Educator support
nodes.reads: The resource includes materials, structure, or guidance for educators and facilitators.

nodes.label: Plant-based
nodes.reads: The option is centered on plants rather than animal-derived ingredients or materials.

nodes.label: Research skills
nodes.reads: The resource helps people learn how to find, verify, organize, or interpret information.

nodes.label: Recycled
nodes.reads: The item uses recycled content, reclaimed material, or a recycled-material design claim.

nodes.label: Digital rights
nodes.reads: The resource focuses on privacy, speech, surveillance, access, power, or civil liberties online.

nodes.label: Offline
nodes.reads: The option can work without continuous cloud access or a permanent internet connection.

nodes.label: Portable
nodes.reads: The option makes it easier to export, move, back up, or migrate your data or purchases.

nodes.label: Security
nodes.reads: The option or resource helps reduce security risk or protect accounts, devices, services, or sensitive information.

nodes.label: Low fees
nodes.reads: The option keeps fees comparatively low or clear for the category.

nodes.label: Climate
nodes.reads: The option is especially relevant to emissions, climate risk, transition finance, energy, or climate education.

nodes.label: Impact
nodes.reads: The option is framed around measurable social, environmental, educational, or community benefit.

nodes.label: Public
nodes.reads: The option is public, civic, school, library, government, or publicly accountable in some meaningful way.

nodes.label: ESG
nodes.reads: The option uses environmental, social, and governance screening or language, which should still be checked for substance.

nodes.label: Critical thinking
nodes.reads: The resource helps people slow down, question claims, compare evidence, and notice weak reasoning.

nodes.label: Encrypted
nodes.reads: The option uses encryption for data in transit, at rest, or in user-to-user communication.

nodes.label: Ads
nodes.reads: The option or resource involves advertising systems, ad transparency, ad-supported access, or advertising literacy.

nodes.label: Fact-checking
nodes.reads: The resource helps verify claims, images, statistics, or stories before sharing or trusting them.

nodes.label: Local
nodes.reads: The option is tied to local services, local reporting, local repair, or place-based support.

nodes.label: Long support
nodes.reads: The option is supported for longer through updates, parts, maintenance, or compatible software.

nodes.label: Employee/member-owned
nodes.reads: Ownership or governance meaningfully sits with employees, workers, members, or a cooperative structure.

nodes.label: No logs
nodes.reads: The service claims not to keep activity logs that would identify ordinary user behavior.

nodes.label: Training controls
nodes.reads: The AI or data service gives users some control over whether their data is used for model training.

nodes.label: Archive
nodes.reads: The option preserves, stores, indexes, or makes historical material available over time.

nodes.label: Audited
nodes.reads: The option has some public audit, review, or independent assessment relevant to the category.

nodes.label: Developer tool
nodes.reads: The option is mainly for people building, testing, hosting, securing, or maintaining software and data systems.

nodes.label: Fintech
nodes.reads: The option is a digital finance, banking, payments, investing, or money-management service.

nodes.label: Library
nodes.reads: The option functions as a library, archive, lending system, or public collection.

nodes.label: Local-first
nodes.reads: The option keeps primary work or data on the user's device or local environment where possible.

nodes.label: Refillable
nodes.reads: The item or service is designed around refills rather than full replacement each time.

nodes.label: Supermarket
nodes.reads: The option is a supermarket, grocery-aisle, or major-retail choice rather than a specialist channel.

nodes.label: Community support
nodes.reads: The resource helps people through local support, navigator programs, mutual aid, libraries, schools, or peer assistance.

nodes.label: Investigative
nodes.reads: The resource emphasizes original reporting, document work, accountability, or deep investigation.

nodes.label: Youth safety
nodes.reads: The resource focuses on protecting children, teens, families, or students online and offline.

nodes.label: Linux
nodes.reads: The option is relevant to Linux, free desktop software, distributions, or Linux-first workflows.

nodes.label: Open education
nodes.reads: The resource supports freely accessible, reusable, or openly licensed teaching and learning materials.

nodes.label: STEM
nodes.reads: The resource supports science, technology, engineering, mathematics, or computational learning.

nodes.label: Zero-waste
nodes.reads: The option aims to reduce disposability, packaging waste, or material throughput.

nodes.label: Beginner
nodes.reads: The option is approachable for people starting a topic or workflow.

nodes.label: No new mining
nodes.reads: The option reduces demand for newly mined minerals through reuse, repair, refurbishment, or existing hardware.

nodes.label: Performance
nodes.reads: The option is chosen partly for technical, athletic, device, or service performance.

nodes.label: Public domain
nodes.reads: The material is free of ordinary copyright restrictions or is presented as public-domain access.

nodes.label: Android
nodes.reads: The option is relevant to Android devices, apps, stores, permissions, or operating-system choices.

nodes.label: DRM-free
nodes.reads: The digital item or service avoids digital-rights-management restrictions that can block ownership, access, or migration.

nodes.label: Verification
nodes.reads: The resource helps confirm authenticity, provenance, identity, claims, images, domains, or records.

nodes.label: EU
nodes.reads: The option is especially relevant to European Union institutions, regulation, availability, or data protection context.

nodes.label: Fast checkout
nodes.reads: The payment option is optimized for speed and convenience at checkout.

nodes.label: Journalism
nodes.reads: The resource supports news reporting, reporting skills, newsroom practice, or journalism education.

nodes.label: Safety check
nodes.reads: The resource helps examine files, links, accounts, domains, or claims before acting on them.

nodes.label: Scam literacy
nodes.reads: The resource helps people recognize, report, and avoid scams, fraud, phishing, or deceptive offers.

nodes.label: Civic data
nodes.reads: The resource helps people use public records, civic datasets, transparency tools, or accountability data.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.reads: The option helps people find information, documents, products, scholarship, records, or web pages.

nodes.label: Global health
nodes.reads: The option focuses on health outcomes, care access, disease prevention, or public health across borders.

nodes.label: End-to-end encrypted
nodes.reads: Messages or data are encrypted so the service operator should not be able to read ordinary content.

nodes.label: Fossil-free
nodes.reads: The option avoids or screens out fossil-fuel financing, ownership, exposure, or direct support where documented.

nodes.label: FSC
nodes.reads: FSC certifies forest management and chain-of-custody claims for paper and wood products.

nodes.label: EWG Verified
nodes.reads: EWG Verified lists products that meet its ingredient and transparency criteria.
